_note: Hand-written cases for core/reading/decide.accept_printing and confirm_by_ocr (the guards of a decision, step 5 of docs/plans/READING_REVIEW_2026-10-21_PLAN.md): the facts in, the answer a person applying the rules by hand expects. NOT produced by running the code. Default thresholds: image_min_similarity 0.5, strong_min_similarity 0.3 (binary fractions are used so that no comparison is close: 0.75, 0.25). A program that decides the same way composes the two: accept_printing(decision, facts); if its answer has needs_ocr, confirm_by_ocr(ocr) decides. 'accept' cases give decision + facts and expect accept_printing's answer; 'confirm' cases give ocr (name_of_other_line absent: false; strip_names absent: null) (and lead, when the picture's lead is part of the case) and expect confirm_by_ocr(ocr, lead)'s. Any program that decides the same way must pass this file too.

cases.name: a strong decision with OCR off is accepted
a strong decision with OCR on needs no confirmation
cases.why: the strip named the printing the picture agrees with: the full-card OCR is asked only about the picture alone

cases.name: a review is no decision and no refusal
the picture alone with OCR off, everything covered, is accepted
the picture alone with OCR on waits for the full-card OCR
the picture alone, a strip naming another indexed printing, passes the strip guards
cases.why: a whole line naming a printing the index HAS: the picture has seen it and still chose another - not a sign of a card the index lacks

cases.name: the picture alone not allowed
the picture alone allowed, and the index lacks printings
the picture alone allowed, and the coverage cannot be said
cases.why: None is not a yes: it fails closed

cases.name: the coverage of the index is no matter to a strong decision
a decided printing the card data no longer has
the picture alone below its floor
the picture alone exactly at its floor passes
cases.why: the floor is reached at equality (< is the refusal)

cases.name: a strong decision below its own floor
a strong decision under the picture alone's floor but over its own passes
the picture alone, the strip names a printing the index lacks
the picture alone, the strip's printing could not be looked up
cases.why: fails closed, under the first strip guard

cases.name: the picture alone, the strip names a printing the card data lacks
the setting is asked before the floor
cases.why: the order: image_alone_off before below_image_floor

cases.name: the card data is asked before the floor
the floor is asked before the strip
the OCR read the name and no whole line
the OCR read the name and the very printing
the OCR read the name and another card's line
cases.why: a Secret Lair prints another card's set and number, or the number was misread: no evidence about this card's printing, the name decides

cases.name: the OCR read another printing of the same card
the OCR read a line the card data lacks
the OCR's line could not be looked up
the OCR read another name
a picture far enough ahead needs no name
cases.why: lead_waives_name 0.1: the picture says which card better than a name OCR misread (a Secret Lair printing another card's name); no whole line read

cases.name: a picture exactly at the waiver's lead needs no name
cases.why: the lead is reached at equality (>=)

cases.name: a picture under the waiver's lead still needs the name
a picture far enough ahead, and nothing read
cases.why: no read at all is no evidence against: the lead stands, as with OCR off

cases.name: a picture far enough ahead, and a line naming another printing of the same card
cases.why: the lead says which card, never which printing: the line is still checked

cases.name: a picture far enough ahead, and a line the card data lacks
a misread name, and a line naming the very printing
cases.why: the picture and the whole collector line agree on the printing - what a 'strong' decision of rule A2 rests on; a Secret Lair prints another card's line, never this one's

cases.name: a misread name, and another card's line
cases.why: another card's line is no evidence for this printing: without the name, or a lead to stand in for it, refused

cases.name: a picture far enough ahead, and the name of the card the OCR's line names
cases.why: the name and a whole collector line agree on ANOTHER card: a contradiction no lead overrules (Codex review, 2026-10-21)

cases.name: a picture far enough ahead, and the name of the card the strip's line names
cases.why: the OCR read no whole line, but the strip's names the card whose name the OCR read

cases.name: a picture far enough ahead, and another card's line under a name that is not that card's
cases.why: a misread number (MSH 0362 for 382) under words that are no card's name: no evidence, the lead stands

cases.name: a picture far enough ahead, and a strip naming another printing of the same card
cases.why: the lead says which card, never which printing: a readable strip naming printing B refuses the picture's A whatever the name (second Codex review, 2026-10-21)

cases.name: the OCR read the name, and a strip naming another printing of the same card
cases.why: the name says which card; the strip's line, like the OCR's own, says which printing - and it is not the chosen one

cases.name: a picture far enough ahead, nothing read, and a strip naming another printing of the same card
cases.why: an OCR that read nothing still carries the strip's line (the caller gathers it whatever was read)

cases.name: a picture far enough ahead, and a strip naming the very printing
the OCR read nothing
cases.why: no read is no confirmation (also what a reader in its cool-down gives)
